description: Full-text search over everything published: posts, case studies, the About, Consulting, Now, Privacy and Résumé pages (his work history is on the résumé), and the projects. Use plain keywords, such as "resumable upload" or "fixed-price audit". Each result is a section; pass its id to fetch to read it.

kind.description: Only this kind: post, case_study, page or project

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10

name: search

id.description: What to pass to fetch: an id, with #anchor for a section

score.description: How well it matches; higher is better

section.description: The section’s heading, or null for opening text or a project

snippet.description: Up to 300 characters from the section

title.description: The title of the post, case study, page or project

total.description: How many sections matched in all

title: Search the site
